sections.content: You know *ir a* + infinitive from A1 Unit 25. Use it to describe personal plans and goals. Combine it with familiar vocabulary for memories, learning and travel: *Voy* a *aprender* *español*. *Vamos* a *viajar*. The structure is useful for saying what you intend to do next.

items.english: I am going to learn Spanish.

items.spanish: Voy a viajar el próximo año.
items.english: I am going to travel next year.
We are going to write our plans.

items.spanish: Carlos va a estudiar español todos los días.
items.english: Carlos is going to study Spanish every day.

sections.content: Only *ir* changes with the person; the verb after *a* stays in the infinitive: *voy a estudiar*, *va a estudiar*, *van a estudiar*.
